cleaner.label: OpenAI Codex (AI)
cleaner.description: Selective cleanup of cache, logs, history, sessions and archived sessions.

option.label: Cache and temporary files
option.description: Deletes local caches and rebuildable temporary data.

option.label: Logs
option.description: Deletes local log files, keeping databases and credentials.

option.label: Prompt history
option.description: Deletes the text history of prompts and interactions.
option.warning: The prompt history will no longer be available.

option.label: Saved sessions
option.description: Deletes the rollout files of active and saved sessions.
option.warning: Irreversible deletion of local conversations. Databases may keep indexes or metadata.

option.label: Archived sessions
option.description: Deletes the rollouts of archived sessions.
option.warning: Deletes archived conversations that you will no longer be able to restore.

option.label: Session index (advanced)
option.description: Deletes the local session index file.
option.warning: You may lose references to the history. Other SQLite databases may still contain metadata.

option.label: Diagnostic databases (advanced)
option.description: Deletes only Codex's diagnostic-log SQLite family, not the user-state one.
option.warning: Make sure Codex is closed, including in the background. Do not select during a running session.
